Added explicit coverage/gap rows for Home Research Dashboard, Universal Search, Dress & Ornament, Houses & Architecture, Livelihood & Economy, Customary Law & Governance, Education / Health / Demography, Geographic / Community Variation, Books / Journals / Theses, Government & Archives, Evidence Explorer, Contradictions & Variants, Research Gaps / Completeness, About and Owner Research Console.

Strengthened tests so CI fails when any registered module lacks a machine-readable coverage/gap mapping, when coverage contains an unregistered module, or when a coverage state falls outside the declared live_partial/structure_ready/authenticated_only/disabled_by_default states.
No cultural facts, source-completeness claims, rights assumptions, community-validation claims or Mundarica VERIFIED COMPLETE states were introduced.
